_doc: Declarative world spec for cw01-e04 (queue/TTL ecology). Written during PREFLIGHT, before implementation. Items arrive in PAIRS separated by a gap, so useful output requires carrying information across time. The channel that spans the gap is bounded, expiring, delayed and lossy. Nothing is named queue, cache, scheduler or retry; the organism experiences physics and pays consequences.

channel._note: Finite, ordered, forgetful, delayed and lossy. The organism never observes TTL, occupancy, or whether a specific value still exists. The object vanishes; it pays the consequence.
channel._full_behaviour: placement into a full channel FAILS SILENTLY and still costs cost_put
channel._capacity_basis: Derived from measured demand, not chosen. Unconstrained occupancy under an ALWAYS-PLACE genome is 6.28; capacity 4 gives a contention ratio of about 1.6 and 55.4 placement failures when everything is placed. The rule was declared BEFORE the triage outcome was known.

items._latent: worth is LATENT: computed from the observable features through a hidden attempt-stable map. The organism sees features, never worth.
items._pairing: an item at step t has a partner at t+gap. Combining both yields info; a lone item yields nothing.

actions.place: put the first member of a pair into the channel (cost_put)
actions.retrieve: attempt to take it back when the partner arrives (cost_get, charged on miss)
actions.recompute: reconstruct the missing information without the channel (cost_recompute) - always available, expensive, reliable
actions.skip: do nothing; the pair yields no info and costs nothing

info_model.paired: log2(1 + worth) when both members are combined
info_model._trade: channel round trip costs 0.7 and may fail; recompute costs 3.0 and never fails; skipping costs 0 and yields 0. For low-worth items skipping can beat both - that is what makes triage non-trivial.

genome._shape: two deterministic linear policies over the 4 observable features, plus 2 neutral genes: place = sigmoid(b_place + w_place . x) > 0.5, recompute = sigmoid(b_rec + w_rec . x) > 0.5
genome._neutral: no phenotype by construction; the drift floor and the basis of cost-matched shams (D011/D027)
genome._uniform_is_reachable: setting all weights to 0 yields a policy that ignores item properties entirely. That is the NULL outcome and it MUST remain reachable; engineering it away would rig the experiment.

arms._critical: Arms are genome/world transformations applied UP FRONT so every arm runs identical code (D019/D021). Drop outcomes are PRE-DRAWN per item from the stream seed, so RNG consumption does not depend on how many placements the organism makes.

control_no_triage._tests: weights forced to zero: may be selective, cannot be conditional on item properties

control_always_recompute._tests: the channel is unavailable; every pair must be recomputed or skipped. The reliable-but-expensive baseline.

measurements.primary: delta(useful_information_transformed / resource_cost) vs ancestor, matched world+budget
measurements.selectivity: fraction of arriving pairs given channel treatment
measurements.triage: mutual information I(item_properties ; handling_decision), against a shuffled null
measurements.triage_competence: correlation between an item's latent worth and the effort spent on it
measurements._separation: Selectivity and triage are TWO INDEPENDENT quantities. High selectivity with zero triage is a policy that is cheap without being informed, and is a NEGATIVE for the triage claim.

J1_scramble_value.effect: permute which observable features predict worth; all costs and physics identical
J1_scramble_value._decisive: a triage policy matched to real structure must collapse; uniform handling should not care

J2_ttl_shock.effect: halve and double ttl_steps after evolution

interventions_post_hoc._generality_note: J2/J3/J4 produce a SEPARATE generality verdict and never upgrade the primary disposition

qualify_predicates._rule: ALL must pass before science budget is spent. Most are STANDING GATES promoted from e01-e03 failures.
qualify_predicates.Q2_channel_is_a_real_trade: measured: a successful channel round trip (0.7) is cheaper than recompute (3.0), but the channel can fail through expiry, delay, loss or capacity - so neither dominates
qualify_predicates.Q3_shams_are_cost_matched: J1's identity permutation must be BIT-IDENTICAL to no intervention and cost exactly the same as the real scramble
qualify_predicates.Q4_seeds_reconstructible: lib/seeds.py, re-asserted cross-process for this attempt_id
qualify_predicates.Q5_durable_without_redis: a row written and re-parsed with the redis import blocked
qualify_predicates.Q7_pressure_actually_binds: capacity 4 is materially smaller than unconstrained demand (occupancy 6.28 under always-place), so carrying is genuinely contested. RE-VERIFIED at the amended capacity: 55.0 placement failures under always-place (was 0.0 at the original capacity 12, which is why the spec was amended).
qualify_predicates.Q8_learnability: STANDING GATE: the BEST conditional policy must beat the BEST policy the NON-CONDITIONAL arm could evolve into (swept, not one arbitrary blind genome), and also beat an ANTI-ALIGNED control at matched selectivity. Probes asserted pairwise distinct.
qualify_predicates.Q9_mechanism_fires: in the hand-built best case, placements and retrieval hits are non-zero and expiries are survivable
qualify_predicates.Q10_matched_arms: with weights zeroed, treatment and control_no_triage produce BIT-IDENTICAL metrics from the same stream seed
qualify_predicates.Q11_triage_MI_calibrated: MI measured with lib/infometrics.mi_with_null; raw MI reads about 0.14 bits on independent data at this sample size, so only the excess over the shuffled null is evidence
qualify_predicates.Q12_disposition_rule_is_executable: disposition computed by lib/lineage.decide; a branch is UNREACHABLE unless its tests ran
qualify_predicates.Q13_latent_worth_is_not_free: the organism observes features only; worth never appears in any decision function
qualify_predicates.Q14_latent_facts_attempt_stable: the property->worth map and the channel physics are drawn ONCE per attempt, never per episode (D029)
qualify_predicates.Q15_no_unperformed_checks: every logged test names the comparison it performed; no ran=True without a real measurement (D031)

backend_counterfactual.requirement_IX: organism-visible physics must not depend on one implementation
backend_counterfactual.secondary_backend: independent reimplementation of the channel physics (explicit list/loop bookkeeping vs the primary representation)
backend_counterfactual.equivalence_test: identical per-organism metric vectors from identical seeds
backend_counterfactual._note: e03 established that a redis swap tests nothing when there is no substrate-backed organism-visible state; IX is discharged against a second IMPLEMENTATION (CW01-D031).
backend_counterfactual.cap_rule: if not exercised within timebox, disposition is capped at INCONCLUSIVE and may NOT be COMPLETE

capacity_sweep.rule: contention ratio ~1.6 (scarce, not thrashing), declared before the outcome
capacity_sweep._reading: the conditional optimum wins with FEWER hits (37.9 vs 48.9) at LOWER cost (56.9 vs 81.5) and far fewer full-channel failures (10.9 vs 55.3): it carries the right things, not more.

amendments.trigger: Q7 failed: capacity never bound (CW01-D032). Learnability comparison also conflated selectivity with worth-alignment (CW01-D033).
changes: channel.capacity 12 -> 4, derived from measured occupancy by a contention rule declared before the triage outcome was known. Choosing capacity 3 - where triage happens to win - would have been fitting the world to the hypothesis.
Q8 restated: best CONDITIONAL vs best NON-CONDITIONAL (swept) plus an ANTI-ALIGNED control at matched selectivity, isolating alignment from volume.
amendments._no_result_observed: No evolutionary run has been performed. These are pre-data corrections to an unchecked spec parameter and a mis-specified comparison.
